Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.

verses.text: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.

xrefs.text: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but He has extended to us grace in the sight of the kings of Persia, giving us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and giving us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.
And I will show you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land.’
The LORD said: “Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will intercede with your enemy in your time of trouble, in your time of distress.
May You forgive Your people who have sinned against You and all the transgressions they have committed against You, and may You grant them compassion in the eyes of their captors to show them mercy.

O Lord, may Your ear be attentive to my prayer and to the prayers of Your servants who delight to revere Your name. Give Your servant success this day, I pray, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” (At that time I was the cupbearer to the king.)

verses.text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.

xrefs.text: Then cry out: ‘Save us, O God of our salvation; gather and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.’
But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!
For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and I will bring you back into your own land.
Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!

verses.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!

xrefs.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said: “May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
